messages:
maria: Heads-up — the Next starter sample (RAG import flow) breaks when people upgrade SDK 0.6.1 -> 0.7.0. Getting import errors and auth retry hangs when running the sample ingest job. Repro steps below.

jon: repro steps? can you paste logs/snippet?

maria: quick logs:```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/pages/api/import.js", line 12, in <module>
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'redwood.llamaindex_adapter'
During batch ingest: 401 returned, retryer spun but no token refresh logged.
```

kevin: sounds like a rename in the SDK export paths + a missing retry hook on ephemeral tokens. the changelog mentions "integration reorg" but sample app still imports the old path.

sam: I hit the auth hang too — when the embed worker gets a 401 it retries but the rotation callback in the starter isn't wired to the new client. end result: job stalls forever with exponential backoff logspam.

lina: quick diff I used locally to unblock: replace
```js
// old
import { LlamaAdapter } from 'redwood.llamaindex_adapter'
// new
import { LlamaAdapter } from '@redwood/integrations/llamaindex'
```
and set the client retryer to use the new onAuthRefresh hook:```js
client.configure({ retry: { onAuthRefresh: async () => await rotateEphemeral() } })
```
That fixed both the import error and the token refresh hang for me.

jon: can you paste a minimal patch as a PR? we should also update the starter generator so new projects don't get broken on upgrade.

maria: pushed a tiny branch with the two-line import change and added the onAuthRefresh wiring to the ingest worker. gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/tmp-repro (private).

kevin: also propose adding an eval harness test that boots the starter with SDK matrix [0.6.x, 0.7.x] and runs the sample import smoke test — will catch reorg breakages early.

sam: agree. CI job can spin a tiny local dev container, run npm run ingest --ci, assert 200 and items > 0. cheap and effective.

lina: I'll update the starter docs section about "Auth hooks and ephemeral tokens" + add the snippet.

jon: opened draft PR 482 in starter repo, linked to an issue to add CI matrix (#1029). tagging @lina for docs.

maria: awesome — thanks all. assigning followups: jon -> PR & template generator, lina -> docs + README snippet, kevin -> eval harness CI change, sam -> flaky retry telemetry. :tada:
